mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize a Teams meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with a Teams Premium or Microsoft 365 Copilot license, but watch two edge cases. Microsoft says recap notes and content aren't currently available for ad-hoc events, and AI summaries only appear for events transcribed in a supported language. Record without transcription and no AI summary appears.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free AI meeting summarizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom records and summarizes unlimited calls at no cost, and its free plan now offers bot-free capture as a Mac beta. The catch with other free tiers is uploads: Otter's free plan allows only 3 audio or video file imports in total, so summarizing old recordings quickly pushes you to a paid plan.

mainEntity.name: Where do I find the AI summary in Zoom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The host gets it automatically once the summary finishes processing, and can share it with participants by email or Zoom Chat. Chat sharing only works if continuous meeting chat is on for that meeting. Participants see nothing unless the host shares it, so ask the host rather than searching your own account.

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet summarize meetings automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not by default for most users, though a Workspace admin can set Take notes for me to switch on automatically for certain meetings. Google recommends it for meetings of 15 minutes to 8 hours. If the organizer shares notes with invited guests, Google means everyone on the invite, not only attendees, so check the list before sensitive calls.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI meeting summary take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually a few minutes. Google says Meet's notes document is generated shortly after the meeting ends, and Zoom shares its summary with the host once processing finishes. Very short calls are the exception: Teams only produces AI summaries for events of 5 minutes or longer. Review names, numbers and owners before sharing.

mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize meetings in Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some tools can. Lynkk supports Hindi, plus a Hinglish setting for speakers who mix Hindi and English, and Read AI lists Hindi among its report languages. Google Meet's Take notes for me leaves Hindi off its 8 languages.
